2610.08446.title: AssemState: Manual and Physical-State-Guided Reasoning for Zero-shot Furniture Assembly
2610.08446.paper_summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have made significant progress in visual understanding, but precise 3D spatial reasoning integrated with physical environment remains difficult. Furniture assembly requires not only recovering step-level operations from diagrammatic manuals, but also translating semantic attachment relations into 6D pose updates that enable parts to physically interact with the environment and previously assembled components. To study this problem, we propose AssemState, a zero-shot framework for manual and physical-state-guided furniture assembly. It firstly employs anchor-guided boundary assembly states to decompose manual pages into single-part operations and recover an assembly-tree. Then, it uses iterative after-state feedback refinement to guide successive (SE(3)) updates and corrections, and validates their physical plausibility through simulation-based release tests. Experiments show that compared with the strongest prior baseline, AssemState improves F1 from 38.58\% to 62.80\% and Tree Exact Match from 28.24\% to 53.92\% for assembly-tree recovery. On 243 independently evaluated part-level operations, our proposed iterative refinement improves judge-accepted operations from 0 to 5.3\% and reduces mean Chamfer distance from 5.4111 to 1.7744. However, visually plausible candidate poses may still suffer from collision, floating, mirror-orientation errors, incomplete seating, and wrong-side attachment. These results show that AssemState improves operation-structure recovery and selected local pose metrics, while MLLMs remain limited for spatial relationship reasoning.
2610.08446.paper_summary_zh: 多模態大型語言模型（MLLMs）在視覺理解方面取得了顯著進展，但與物理環境整合的精確3D空間推理仍然困難。<lb/>家具組裝不僅需要從圖示手冊中恢復步驟級操作，還需要將語義附加關係轉換為6D姿態更新，以使部件能夠與環境及先前組裝的組件進行物理互動。<lb/>為了研究這個問題，我們提出了AssemState，一個零-shot框架，用於手動和物理狀態引導的家具組裝。<lb/>它首先利用錨點引導的邊界組裝狀態將手冊頁面分解為單部件操作並恢復組裝樹。<lb/>然後，它使用迭代的後狀態反饋細化來指導後續的（SE(3)）更新和修正，並通過基於模擬的釋放測試驗證其物理合理性。<lb/>實驗顯示，與最強的先前基準相比，AssemState將F1從38.58\%提高到62.80\%，將樹精確匹配從28.24\%提高到53.92\%，用於組裝樹的恢復。<lb/>在243個獨立評估的部件級操作中，我們提出的迭代細化將評審接受的操作從0提高到5.3\%，並將平均Chamfer距離從5.4111降低到1.7744。<lb/>然而，視覺上合理的候選姿態仍可能遭遇碰撞、懸浮、鏡像方向錯誤、不完全就座和錯誤側附加等問題。<lb/>這些結果表明，AssemState改善了操作結構的恢復和選定的局部姿態指標，而MLLMs在空間關係推理方面仍然有限。
